SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2838.
Date 29. 10. 31.

Translation of a letter from Wu Heng-jui of the
Social Bureau of the Shanghai Municipality to
Superintendent Tan Shao-liang, Special Branch.

---

October 28, 1931.

Dear Mr. Tan,

One of our investigators named Loh Yi-
mur reported yesterday that while making investigations
in Yangtszepoo District he was taken by a policeman on
duty there to the police station where he was detained
for about an hour although he had shown them his
identification card of investigator issued by this
Bureau. In addition to paying no attention to the
card, the police even seized the investigation book
and forms. As the object of this Bureau in carrying
out the investigation is to compile statistics relating
to business conditions and as our investigator has
never intruded into any shop, it is beyond doubt that
no breach of peace and order has been created. Besides
in view of the fact that the identification card showed
by our investigation is sufficient to show his standing
how can that policeman arrest and detain him at his own
will, thus obstructing the discharge of public functions?
What is more ridiculous is the subsequent confiscation
of the investigator's books and forms by the police. In
fact, on what authority does that policeman make use of
his good office and commit this arrogant act? Please
make investigation into this matter and favour us with
a reply as early as possible.

Yours etc.

(Sd & Chopped) Wu Heng-jui.
Chief of 2nd Dept
Social Bureau.

（批：Office of S.B.
Forwarded
Tan Shaoliang
Supt.
29/10）

特务科档案室
编号：S. B. D. 2838。
日期：1931年10月29日。

上海市社会局吴恒瑞致特务科督察长谭绍良函译文。

---

1931年10月28日。

谭先生台鉴：

我局一名名为罗义穆（Loh Yi-mur，音译）的调查员昨日报告称，他在杨树浦地区进行调查时，被当地一名执勤警察带至警察局，尽管他出示了由本局签发的调查员身份证，仍被拘留约一小时。警方不仅未予理会该证件，甚至没收了调查记录本及表格。本局开展调查之目的，在于编制有关商业状况的统计数据，且我方调查员从未进入任何店铺内部，毫无疑问并未引发任何扰乱治安秩序之行为。此外，鉴于我方调查员所出示的身份证足以证明其身份，该警察怎能擅自将其逮捕并拘留，从而阻碍公务之执行？更为荒谬的是，警方随后没收了调查员的记录本和表格。事实上，该警察凭借何种职权，利用职务之便做出如此傲慢之举？请对此事进行调查，并尽早赐复。

此致

（签名及盖章）吴恒瑞。
社会局第二科科长。

（批注：特务科办公室
转交
谭绍良
督察长
10月29日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & Yangtzepoo Station,
No. S. B. D. 2858.
Date October 28, 1931
29.10.31.）

File No. ____

Subject (in full) Illegal Functioning of Chinese Authorities

Made by ____ and Forwarded by C/Inspector, Foley

Sir,
    Herewith the card and registration book which was found
in the possession of one Loh Zeu Tsong No. 2 Pakhoi Road,
when he was observed recording shop numbers and names of
shop owners on Yangtszepoo Road at 4.40 P.M. 27th inst. He
claimed to be working for The Bureau of Social Affairs, The
City Government of Greater Shanghai, the ultimate object being
to compile a Chinese Hong List with the names addresses etc
of important shops and Hongs in the Settlement. He also
claimed he was now working on the job for about two months.
He was not in possession of any document whatever from the
Council which would entitle him to function within the
Settlement. On your advise he was allowed to go, being told
a report on his activities would be forwarded to Headquarters
together with his card and book.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Foley.
C/Inspector.

Officer i/c Political Department.

（左侧批注：Supt 29.10）
D. C. Brine.
Sir, Information
H.R. 28/10

Supt Yan,
As spoken please

日期：1931年10月28日
1931年10月29日。）

档案号 ____

事由（全称）：中国当局人员非法行使职权

呈报人 ____ 并由 Foley 总督察转呈

阁下：
随函附上在罗泽宗（Loh Zeu Tsong，音译，地址：北四川路2号）身上搜获的证件及登记簿。本月27日下午4时40分，有人发现他在杨树浦路上记录店铺号码及店主姓名。他声称受雇于大上海市政府社会局，最终目的是编制一份包含租界内重要商铺及洋行名称、地址等信息的华商名录。他还声称从事此项工作已约两个月。他未能出示任何由工部局签发、允许其在租界内行使职权的文件。根据您的建议，已准许其离开，并告知将把他的活动报告连同其证件和记录簿一并呈送总部。

卑职
J. Foley 谨上。
总督察。

政治部主管警官。

（左侧批注：督察长 10月29日）
D. C. Brine.
